# R2.10 — Credential-broker legs: `audience` verifies, `dpop` stays typed-refused, Stage-3 image-manifest canaries

Ticket `docs/tickets/116_R2.10__credential-broker-legs.md` (seq 116).
Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.9b` (PR #116); ADR-0342.
Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — no live/staging
environment, no production mutation, no OAuth/mTLS exchange (R2.19's
seam); LT-03's live-corpus/foreign arms stay R2.21.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.13-1 · DF-S1.13-3 · R-2.8.3 · BL-19.

## What landed

**`audience` verifies (ADR-0342 D1) — the channel no longer refuses.**
`bind` admits a `sender_constraint = audience` channel on
`minted_scoped` and injected modes — the audience *is* the
destination, fenced by the existing `destinations ⊆
channel.destinations` check. `mint` refuses
`Refused{out_of_scope}` when the requested audience is outside the
binding's declared destinations — a token minted for an unreachable
audience would be an unverifiable claim, never silently scoped.
`verify_minted` checks the token's audience destination-side as
landed. Deliberately string/set membership — the honest offline
verification, not an RFC-8707 claim.

**`dpop` stays `SenderConstraintUnmet` — on every delivery mode
(ADR-0342 D2).** Pure-std has no asymmetric signature verifier and the
hermetic-deps contract forbids importing one; an unverifiable
constraint never fabricates an accept. The refusal moved out of the
`minted_scoped`-only gate — an injected-mode bind on a `dpop` channel
was previously unenforced; now fail-closed on every leg. DF-S1.13-1's
dated residual records the reason + revisit trigger (the ticket's own
note: "the `dpop` cell is a trap for fabrication").

**Stage-3 image-manifest canary (ADR-0342 D3/D4) — DF-S1.13-3's last
cell DONE.** `EnvironmentRecord.canary_channels: Vec<CanaryChannel>`
(`{channel_id, spec}`, `spec.canary` must be `true`) is the §05h I3
`environment` bundle member — identity-bearing (a different canary set
is a different image). `provision`/`provision_hosted` run the
fail-closed admission: `needs_adapter` (Stage-3) class with no canary
⇒ `CanaryManifest{missing}`; non-`canary:true` member ⇒ `non_canary`;
declared canary with no broker ⇒ `broker_absent`; a channel id under a
different spec ⇒ `register:<id>` conflict. Registration lands on the
run's `CredentialBroker` *before* the adapter stands a remote up; an
identical-spec re-registration is idempotent (same-image re-provision
/ derived child on the shared broker). `EnvHandle.canary_channels` +
the `action.environment.provisioned` payload record the ids (ids only
— CC2); `derive` inherits the parent's set. `hh-embed` provision call
sites pass the service's credential broker.

**DF/BL dispositions.** DF-S1.13-1 — OPEN with dated progress; the
`audience` half discharges, residual narrows to `dpop` (structural)
+ `credential_supply` (DF-S1.13-4's). DF-S1.13-3 — DONE (the canary
cell was the last open member). BL-19 — stays `open` (the named DPoP
feature is a typed residual, not delivered); evidence cell updated.
COVERAGE R-2.8.3 — stays PARTIAL, notes refreshed (stale DF-S2.4-3
residual cleared — DONE at R2.9b).
